newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 1,002,900 MT were 63 percent above the previous week and the 4-week average.

Japan (562,700 MT, after cancelling 131,300 tonnes) was the dominant buyer followed by South Korea (108,200 MT), Mexico (92,400 MT), Taiwan (81,000 MT), Portugal (65,000 MT), and Colombia (59,600 MT).

Reductions were reported for unknown destinations (52,000 MT). Exports of 958,300 MT were one-half greater than the week earlier and 38 percent more than the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (340,600 MT), Taiwan (227,400 MT), Mexico (138,800 MT), Egypt (69,900 MT), and South Korea (55,100 MT).
Optional origin sales of 55,000 MT for Malaysia were switched to 1997/98.
